status: completed relevance and independent occurrence-evidence review

review.requirement_proposition: Where possible, do not unduly withhold service solely because a subject chooses not to provide, or fails to provide, effective informed consent.

previous_withheld_assessment.applicability_basis: The July 2026 Xbox outage concerns physical-game entitlement checks and service availability. The evidenced service failure was an Xbox physical-game entitlement outage. It concerns game licensing/access checks, not an emulated-empathy system withholding service solely because a subject declined effective informed consent.

review.reason_for_change: The Xbox outage withheld some disc access because remote licence verification was unavailable, not because an affective-data subject declined effective informed consent. No AI/affective-data collection or such consent-conditioned service is identified; the recovered historical requirement has a different object and trigger.

independent_relevance_review: All preserved occurrence sources were considered. Remote entitlement dependency and Xbox disc access identify conventional licensing/service continuity; no AI system, AI actor activity or matching canonical AI requirement is established. Mechanism analogy does not establish source-object relevance.
